public_rationale: The comparable reported figures fall from 92.2% in November 2022 to 89.34% in October 2024, a decline of approximately 2.9 percentage points. In the context of predictions that ChatGPT would displace Google, that supports the ordinary reading of a modest decline. It does not imply that Google's share was unchanged or that ChatGPT caused the decline.
limitations: The figures come from secondary reporting of Statcounter because historical primary data were not retrievable.
The measure does not capture every search query or chatbot answer.
Calling the decline modest is an interpretation of Marcus's qualitative wording.
The endpoint is October, the last complete month before publication.
